summary: Petrobras filed a Form 6-K (US equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report) disclosing receipt of R$448 million under Brazil's gasoline economic subsidy program, covering sales from July 16–31, 2026, per Provisional Measure No. 1,358/2026. Cumulative receipts across diesel, gasoline and LPG subsidy programs now total R$9.9 billion. No securities transaction, shareholder action, board recommendation or advisor is involved; no price per share, premium, ownership change or regulatory clock applies. This is routine government-subsidy cash-receipt disclosure, not a special situation; no risk-arb angle exists.
